يستلذوا (form X)
# يَسْتَلِذُّوا (yastaliḏḏū) /jas.ta.lið.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# يُسْتَلَذُّوا (yustalaḏḏū) /jus.ta.lað.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
